name: ship_type_t__load
notes: ship_type_t::load(this, filename): WSHP magic, version, name_len, name, 7 params (0x1C bytes) @+8, 72 sprites @+0x24

name: ship_speed
notes: trunc(floor(20*sqrt((vx/2000f)^2+(vy/2000f)^2))) = speed in 1/100 px/tick; verified recon/core/ship.c (dive trace)

name: player_spawn_init
notes: (player*, x, y, hp): reset player state, copy ship params p0..p5 to +0xE8..+0xFC

name: player_apply_confusion
notes: control-scramble status effect: timer +0x10C, kind +0x110 swaps key flags

name: player_on_base
notes: snap angle: material==3 -> 180 (zero v/sub if not already 180), else push_vy<0 ? 180 : 0; angle10=angle*10

name: player_cycle_weapon
notes: cycle secondary weapon +0x38 by dir, skip unavailable (+0x40[w]==0), 1..34

name: splash
notes: splash(x,y,speed): sound +0x168, speed/4 particles in pool 0x59AA0 (40), 2x random_n(36) each

name: snd_loop_frame_end
notes: stops looping sounds not kept alive this tick

name: flip
notes: called every frame in main loop

name: sound_play
notes: (sample*, prio, 0, vol): channel allocator over 0x605C0 channels, no RNG

name: match_main
notes: match setup + in-game frame loop (ship update inlined 0x3531C-0x35F00)

name: player_apply_damage
notes: apply damage_acc: attacker resolve, shield -15, flash (0x1F, timer=max(timer,d), >=2), hp -= d, player_die

name: player_die
notes: (x, y, idx): death effects + respawn; uses random_n

name: player_terrain_collide
notes: single-pixel material test at next position: air/fire, water+current (0.952), class 8 (0.65), solid halve+damage+axis test, base landing, material, rest-on-base, repair

name: attacker_lookup
notes: (idx): grab/net pools 0x994A0 (40 B) / 0x99638 (92 B) -> attacker index or -1

name: material_class
notes: palette index -> class 0..8 (0 air: 0/54/64-79, 1 solid: rest, 2 base 32-47, 3 water 48-51, 4 indestr 80-95, 5 base-indestr 38-39, 6 soft 96-111, 7 burning 112-127, 8: 6/17-20/53 [?]); ported recon/core/material.c

name: level_set_pixel
notes: bounds-checked pixel write; mask 0x9B410 = c?0xFF:0 when byte 0x9AB9B == 1

name: sqrt
notes: fld qword [esp+4]; fsqrt; ret (libm, not in djdev201 libc)

name: random
notes: DJGPP v2.01 libc random() (BSD additive feedback); corrected from rand

name: g_keytable_live
notes: 256 bytes key-down flags written by INT9 ISR

name: g_player_kind
notes: per player: 1 human local, 2 computer, 3 remote

name: g_repair
notes: hp per 10 ticks on own base = max(1, opt_ship_strength_pct/100)
